data.title: 白井黑子 · 落地窗晚风里的星光依偎
data.description: 高层公寓的落地窗前，学园都市璀璨的霓虹地平线在脚下铺展。黑子赤着双足伫立在随风翻卷的白纱窗帘边，身穿轻柔贴身的海军蓝吊带裙。当一双手臂从背后环抱住她时，黑子嘴角浮现出满足的浅笑，侧过脸迎上少年的目光，任由晚风撩动彼此的发丝。
data.action: standing barefoot by window, back hug, wind blowing sheer curtains
data.lighting: dazzling panoramic city lights reflecting on glass
data.promptProse: Standing barefoot before panoramic high-rise windows overlooking the Academy City skyline at night, Shirai Kuroko leans back into a tender embrace. The evening wind billows sheer white curtains around her navy slip dress as city lights shimmer in her eyes.
data.animaCaption: Kuroko embraced gently by the panoramic city-view window at night.
